brand.name: Optic MindLabs
brand.tagline: We proudly turn movements into meaning.
brand.positioning: A Canadian-founded technology company built for a global market: capture technology and a cloud platform that turn what a camera sees into what a business needs to know. The visual system is precise and composed, built on the kintsugi principle: the fracture is where the gold goes.
brand.narrative: The world generates enormous amounts of visual and physical data every day, and almost none of it gets used. Optic MindLabs builds the tools to capture it - vision, lidar, audio, and Wi-Fi sensing that detects people, vehicles, animals, and objects in motion - and turn it into reports, alerts, and action. Kintsugi - the Japanese art of mending with gold - is the governing metaphor: the world is full of gaps in awareness, and Optic MindLabs traces those fractures and fills them with intelligence. The slogan is literal: Capture. Analyze. Optimize. is the order we build in.

company.origin: Founded in Canada, anchored in North America, built for a global market.
company.sensing: Vision, lidar, audio, and Wi-Fi capture that detects people, vehicles, animals, and objects in motion - direction, movement, size, colour, and safety-relevant details like hard hats and safety vests.
company.hardware: Multi-sensor capture device (working name 'da'box'). Business/enterprise line built for scale - job sites, facilities, fleets - available for purchase or rent; a retail residential product brings the same technology home, sized and priced for everyday households.
company.platform: Cloud-based SaaS portal and mobile app on subscription tiers for everyone from a homeowner to a small nonprofit to a large enterprise. Analyzes patterns and anomalies and can trigger real-world responses (a text, an email, a control switch), enriched with weather and geolocation data.
company.research: The research lab the company is named for: fully funded research partnerships with corporations and educational institutions, producing two to three industry papers a year, giving staff and select students genuinely cutting-edge problems.

leadership.name: Daniel Blair
leadership.summary: Educator, researcher, and technologist in immersive technology and AI; founder and CTO of BSD XR; instructor in the ACE Project Space at Red River College Polytechnic; award-winning entrepreneur focused on ethical deployment of emerging technology. Leads the technology vision: sensing hardware, the AI behind it, and the research lab.

leadership.name: Jerin Valel
leadership.summary: COO at IDFusion; former Deputy Minister of Economic Development, Investment and Trade and former Assistant Deputy Minister; executive roles at Permission Click, Bell, and MTS across a 20-year public/private career. Leads operational and go-to-market discipline: turning proven technology into a company governments and enterprises can trust.

company.namingNote: Written name: 'Optic MindLabs'. Wordmark lockup renders OPTICMIND / LABS; the production logo art reads 'Optic Mind Labs'. Product names and division structure (e.g. 'da'box') are working language and may evolve.

productionLogo.usage: Official production lockup (dome camera with AI core, particle ring, wordmark, tagline). Use on Obsidian or near-black backgrounds only; blend the black plate with mix-blend-mode: screen on dark surfaces.

kintsugiVein.usage: Hero backdrop texture at 0.2-0.3 opacity with a radial vignette into Obsidian; also cropped as a corner texture on cards.

kintsugiVase.usage: Brand-story imagery for the kintsugi idea.

motif.name: Kintsugi gold seams
motif.principle: The seam is the connective tissue - section dividers, hero edges, data flows. Thin, irregular, alive. Never decorative noise; always a path with meaning.
rules: Draw seams as thin (1-2.5px) irregular polylines in the gold gradient.
Use photographic kintsugi textures only at low opacity behind heroes, vignetted into Obsidian.
Keep seams secondary to content; never flood a layout with gold.

guidelines: Use measurable details and operational specifics - latency in milliseconds, coverage in square kilometers.

Be plain-spoken and literal about what things do: 'turns what a camera sees into what a business needs to know'. The slogan is presented as fact, in build order: 'Capture. Analyze. Optimize. That's not just a slogan we picked for effect. It's the order we build in.'
Anchor benefits in outcomes: help people see clearly, decide faster, and stay safer.
Speak to the full range of audiences with the same respect - an enterprise job site tracking hard hats and a homeowner keeping an eye on their property.
Frame technology as serving people and places: we connect, we don't surveil.
Lean on the kintsugi idea - fractures traced and filled with intelligence - for brand moments.
Avoid vague futurism, fear-based surveillance language, and exaggerated claims.

kintsugiGold.usage: Signature accent, seams, logo strokes, and key actions

midGold.usage: Gradient mid-stop and secondary gold accents

pearl.usage: Primary text on dark, light surface applications

stone.usage: Card body copy and tertiary text

goldSignature.usage: Signature kintsugi gradient - logo strokes, seams, large gold surfaces

goldVertical.usage: Iris fills, dots, node particles, thin seam highlights

goldText.usage: Gradient-clipped wordmarks and emphasized headline words

accent.name: Cormorant Garamond
accent.usage: Hero statements and brand moments (often italic, gradient-clipped on the key word), editorial accents, pull quotes

marks.apertureEye: Primary vector mark: camera iris nested in an eye with hexagonal intelligence frame and a single gold seam.
marks.swarmIris: Edge nodes resolving into one iris; echoes the particle ring of the production lockup.
marks.fracturedO: Monogram for tight spaces (favicons, app tiles): a lens cracked and rejoined in gold.

logo.clearspace: At least one iris-height around the mark

do: Use Obsidian as the dominant canvas.
Use gold sparingly for meaningful signal - a seam, never a flood.
Use the production lockup (assets/opticmind-labs-logo.png) for official outward-facing applications on dark backgrounds.
Use kintsugi photo textures at low opacity behind heroes, vignetted into Obsidian.
Use Cormorant Garamond (often italic, gold gradient on the key word) for hero statements and brand moments.
Keep cards and controls at 6px radius.
Use Space Grotesk for display and UI labels, Manrope for operational content.
Use thin, irregular gold seam lines to connect sections or show data flow.
dont: Do not use off-palette blues, pastels, or playful gradients.
Do not flood layouts with gold.
Do not place the logo on light or busy mid-tone backgrounds.
Do not blur, lower opacity of, distort, or recolor the mark.
Do not use ornate decoration without functional meaning.
Do not use vague futurist or fear-based copy.

agentPrompts.uiImplementation: Use the Optic MindLabs brand kit. Load brand-styles.json and follow skills/opticmind-brand/SKILL.md. Build a dark, precise, operational interface: Obsidian canvas, Graphite panels, sparse Kintsugi Gold seams and accents, Space Grotesk headings, Manrope body, Cormorant Garamond italic only for brand-moment statements. Keep radii at 6px, reserve gold for signal, dividers, and primary actions, and use kintsugi textures only as low-opacity hero backdrops vignetted into Obsidian.
agentPrompts.copywriting: Write in the Optic MindLabs voice: precise, composed, plain-spoken, human. Slogan: 'Capture. Analyze. Optimize.' - always presented as what we do, in the order we build. Tagline: 'We proudly turn movements into meaning.' Outcomes: help people see clearly, decide faster, stay safer. Write for the full range of audiences - enterprise, government, nonprofit, homeowner - with the same respect. Use specific operational language and measurable outcomes (see the company section of brand-styles.json for facts), and lean on the kintsugi idea for brand moments. Avoid hype, vague futurism, fear-based surveillance language, and exaggerated claims.
agentPrompts.visualAsset: Create an Optic MindLabs visual asset: obsidian background, restrained gold seams, engineered composition, high contrast. Use the eye/iris/hexagon motif or the swarm particle ring when it clarifies the message, and the production dome-camera lockup (assets/opticmind-labs-logo.png) for official applications. Kintsugi photo textures only at low opacity behind heroes. No off-brand blues, playful gradients, pastels, heavy decoration, or blurry stock imagery.
